name: Mitten Extracts | 2g Disposable | Strawberry Sherbet
description: Like a dessert you can’t resist, Strawberry Sherbet delivers creamy, candy-like flavor with a refreshing fruity kick. Balanced as a hybrid should be, this 2g disposable brings a smooth, uplifting buzz that still keeps you grounded. Perfect for daytime sessions, social vibes, or just treating yourself, Strawberry Sherbet is the sweet spot between flavor and feel.
